resources.string: Badges read notifications on this device only. Notification contents are never saved or uploaded.
Counts come from active notifications, not every unread message. Dynamic pictures are kept only in memory. Media cards can use the same access to show and control playback.
Not granted yet. Badges stay hidden until you allow access.
Badges are off. Enabled media cards may still use shared notification access.
Access granted, but the notification service is disconnected. Badges stay empty until it reconnects.
To remove the access completely, switch it off in Android\'s notification access settings.
This device has no notification access settings screen.
Badges from a paused work profile or a locked private space are never shown.
